newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse allows Rattana trade resumption.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse allows Rattana trade resumption.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand said trading would resume in the shares of now halted Rattana Real Estate Plc from the afternoon session on Friday.
The SET said it allowed resumption of trading because the company had disclosed full details, clarifying newspaper reports about a bankruptcy suit against the company.
Rattana earlier reported it had reached a compromise agreement with French construction firm Societe Auxiliare D'Entreprises on a suit against it. Details of the suit were not given.
